evals.prompt: The Boot 4 upgrade we merged to dev on app-media-api yesterday is unsafe. Back it out on dev but keep the work so the code owner can review it later.
evals.expected_output: Claude follows references/revert-and-isolate.md: a revert commit on a fresh branch from origin/dev, a forward version bump through klever-mr, revert_check.py before push, approval before merge, and a revert-of-the-revert Draft MR for the re-opened work.
expectations: Claude uses git revert (with -m 1 for a merge commit), never reset --hard or a force push
Claude bumps the version forward, never back to the pre-merge version
Claude runs or proposes scripts/revert_check.py with --allow for the version file and CHANGELOG before pushing
Claude does not merge the revert MR without explicit user approval
Claude re-opens the work by reverting the revert commit on a new branch as a Draft MR, not by re-merging the old feature branch or restoring a whole tree
